_help: Order here = order on the page. 'featured': true shows the card straight away, false puts it behind 'More projects'. 'art' = file name (no .svg) in src/art/, the small hover animation. 'tag' is an optional red label such as 'in progress'. 'link' (optional) adds a 'Code' or 'Write-up' link under the card text; check it opens before you add it. To remove a project, delete its {...} block (and its art file if nothing else uses it).

items.title: UAV-based polling of sensor nodes in agriculture
items.text: A drone visits ground sensor nodes across a field and collects their data.
items.hint: hover: the drone polls each node

items.title: Anomaly detection in IIoT networks
items.meta: Academic · TU Ilmenau · supervised by M.Sc. Ariel Aguirre
items.text: Six models compared on 1,194,464 network flows. Found and removed a label leak. Tree models scored 1.00 on an unseen attack; the graph models scored 0.04.

items.title: Database re-architecture
items.text: Split reads and writes on Aurora PostgreSQL. Cost down 20%, query performance up 30%.

items.title: API proxy bottleneck
items.text: Dashboards and alerts found a five-month bottleneck. Peak latency down 40% for 1.5M+ users.

items.title: Stereo source separation
items.text: Separates two mixed voices (LibriSpeech): SIR 7 to 9 dB, SDR 5 to 7 dB, SAR 12 to 15 dB.

items.title: VAE for IoT anomaly detection
items.text: A PyTorch variational autoencoder for anomaly detection on the N-BaIoT dataset, with preprocessing and evaluation scripts.
items.hint: hover: data passes through the bottleneck

items.title: x86 to ARM migration
items.text: Compute cost down 25%, performance up 15% for a critical EC2 application.

items.title: SOC 2 Type II controls
items.text: Sole architect of the technical controls: 20+ IAM policies, a company VPN, secrets moved into AWS Secrets Manager, image scanning in the deploy path.

items.title: Smartservers fleet
items.text: Managed 1,500+ third-party servers from several providers, provisioned with Cloud-Init scripts (Docker, NewRelic logging, firewall rules).

items.title: Disaster-recovery deployment

items.title: Attendance by face recognition
items.text: A Raspberry Pi 3 B+ with a camera recognised students, with or without masks, and logged attendance in seconds instead of minutes.
